australia.name: Australia
australia.intro: For a holiday or a visit to family in Australia. Apply from outside Australia through ImmiAccount and follow the document list for your application.

sections.title: Identity and itinerary
docs: A clear colour copy of your passport identity page. Include previous visas or travel stamps where relevant.
Your intended dates, places to visit and accommodation or host details.
A letter explaining your visit and your plans after returning to India.

sections.title: How you will cover the trip
docs: Itemised personal bank statements showing savings and regular income. Home Affairs gives three months as an example.
Evidence of any other funds you will rely on, such as tax records, investments or business income.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: If someone is hosting or paying for you
docs: A signed invitation giving your host’s address, your relationship, the dates and who will pay for what.
If your host is funding the visit, proof of their funds and, where requested, their identity and residence status.
If you are applying with a child, check the destination’s requirements for birth records, custody or parental consent.

sources.label: Australian Home Affairs · visitor application documents
Australian Home Affairs · Tourist stream

canada.name: Canada
canada.intro: Your reason for visiting determines the checklist in your online IRCC account. For a holiday or family visit, start with your passport, travel plans and evidence of how you will fund the trip.

sections.title: Personal and travel documents
docs: A copy of your current passport identity page, plus any pages the application portal requests.
Previous visas and entry or exit stamps that show your travel history.
Proposed dates, accommodation and a short itinerary. If you will stay with family, give their address and the purpose of your visit.

sections.title: Funds and ties to India
docs: Bank statements with your name, account details and about six months of activity to show how you will pay for the trip.
Tax returns or evidence of other savings, if they explain the funds shown in your application.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: If someone is hosting or paying for you
docs: A signed invitation giving your host’s address, your relationship, the dates and who will pay for what.
If your host is funding the visit, proof of their funds and, where requested, their identity and residence status.
If you are applying with a child, check the destination’s requirements for birth records, custody or parental consent.

sections.title: After submitting the application
docs: If IRCC sends a biometrics instruction letter, take it and your passport to the collection appointment.
Follow the passport submission instructions if IRCC requests your original passport.

canada.timing: Processing times vary. Check IRCC’s current estimate for visitor applications from India when choosing travel dates.

sources.label: IRCC · visitor visa and supporting documents
IRCC · check processing times

china.name: China
china.intro: This quote covers a sticker visa for a commercial visit. The invitation from your Chinese business partner and the covering letter from your company should describe the same business activity and dates.

sections.title: Passport and application
docs: The completed Chinese visa application with your own email address and phone number.
Your passport with more than six months’ validity and at least two blank visa pages, plus its information pages. Include previous passports issued within the past five years.
Two recent colour photographs with a white background, 33 mm wide by 48 mm high, taken within six months. Include copies of any Chinese visas obtained in the past three years.

sections.title: From your company in India
docs: A signed letter on company letterhead giving your role, the company’s activities and year of establishment, the specific purpose of the visit and the exact dates.
A proposed return itinerary and details of the meetings or trade event.

sections.title: From your business partner in China
docs: An invitation stating the purpose, dates and contact details, signed by hand and bearing the inviting company’s official seal.

A copy of the inviting company’s business licence and the inviter’s or legal representative’s ID. Follow the embassy’s Chinese handwritten endorsement, signature and date instructions for both copies.

sources.label: Chinese Embassy in India · visa documents and M visa instructions
Chinese Embassy in India · where to submit

dubai.name: Dubai (UAE)
dubai.intro: These options cover a pre-arranged UAE tourist visa for travel to Dubai. Tell us your intended stay and number of entries so we can confirm the right option.

sections.title: Passport and photograph
docs: A clear colour scan of your passport identity and address pages and a scan of the outer cover for file preparation.
A recent colour photograph against a white background.
Check that your passport will be valid for at least six months on arrival.

sections.title: Travel and stay
docs: Your return or onward flight itinerary.
A hotel voucher covering your stay, or your host’s details if you will stay privately.
For file preparation, have your PAN card available if requested for your booking. Confirm the document handover method with the visa team.

dubai.timing: Our standard estimate is 7–8 working days after submission. Express handling is estimated at 24–48 working hours. UAE immigration sets the decision date.

sources.label: Dubai immigration · tourist entry permit
Dubai immigration · visa on arrival eligibility for Indian citizens

europe.name: Europe (Schengen)
europe.intro: For a tourist trip across one or more Schengen countries. Apply through your main destination, taking account of the purpose and length of stay. If the stays are equal and there is no main destination, use the country you enter first.
europe.rateCaption: Appointment and LeisureFlies service fee only.
europe.rateNote: Pay the consular fee directly at your VFS appointment, or through the official portal if your destination requires online payment. Travel insurance is extra and depends on your age and trip length.

sections.title: Passport, form and insurance
docs: A passport issued within the past 10 years, with two blank pages and at least three months’ validity after you plan to leave the Schengen area.
A completed, signed application and a recent photograph in the format your destination requests.
Travel medical insurance for every Schengen country and every day of the trip, with at least €30,000 cover for emergency treatment, hospital care and repatriation.

sections.title: Itinerary and accommodation
docs: A covering letter with the purpose of travel, dates and anyone travelling with you.
Return transport reservations and a day-by-day route. For a multi-country trip, include travel between destinations.
Accommodation for each night, or an invitation and address from a private host.

sections.title: Evidence of funds
docs: Recent personal bank statements showing regular activity and enough funds for your plans.
Income tax records or other evidence of income requested on your main destination’s checklist. The required evidence varies by country.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: If someone is hosting or paying for you
docs: A signed invitation giving your host’s address, your relationship, the dates and who will pay for what.
If your host is funding the visit, proof of their funds and, where requested, their identity and residence status.
If you are applying with a child, check the destination’s requirements for birth records, custody or parental consent.

europe.timing: The usual decision time is 15 calendar days after a complete application is lodged. It can extend to 45 days. Allow additional time to find an appointment.

sources.label: European Commission · applying for a Schengen visa

georgia.name: Georgia
georgia.intro: Use the Georgian e-visa portal to check your passport and travel purpose. Its questions determine which supporting documents apply to you.

sections.title: Identity and application
docs: A clear passport identity-page scan and a recent digital biometric photograph.
Your intended dates and the supporting visa or residence permit if requested for your circumstances.

sections.title: Your trip to Georgia
docs: Proof of accommodation for the whole stay and a return or onward travel reservation.
Travel and health insurance valid for your visit.
Evidence of sufficient funds for the trip, such as a recent bank statement. Have the supporting documents available for border checks.

sources.label: Embassy of Georgia in India · e-visa and border documents
Georgia e-visa portal · documents by nationality

iceland.name: Iceland
iceland.intro: Use this country checklist when Iceland is your main Schengen destination. Include each overnight stop and the transport between them.

sections.title: Application and travel
docs: A passport issued within the past 10 years, with two blank pages and at least three months’ validity after you plan to leave the Schengen area.
The online Iceland application confirmation, signed Schengen application and a recent 35 × 45 mm photograph.
Travel medical insurance for every Schengen country and every day of the trip, with at least €30,000 cover for emergency treatment, hospital care and repatriation.
Return flight reservation with your name and booking reference, plus transport reservations between Schengen countries.
Accommodation for every stop and a covering letter naming your travel companions and dates.

sections.title: Funds and sponsorship
docs: Personal bank statements for the past three months, stamped and signed as the India checklist specifies, and Indian tax acknowledgements for the last two assessment years.
If sponsored, include the signed sponsorship letter, sponsor’s ID and evidence of funds. For a private visit, check Iceland’s invitation and guarantee forms.

Salaried: Employment contract, approved leave and three months of payslips.
Self-employed: Company registration or GST details, business statements and tax evidence.
Student: A current enrolment certificate from your school or college.
Retired: Three months of pension statements or evidence of regular retirement income.

sections.title: Children and business visits
docs: For a child travelling alone or with one parent, prepare parental consent or sole-custody evidence and copies of the parents’ ID as applicable.
For a business visit, include the Icelandic host’s invitation and employer’s letter with matching dates and purpose.

sources.label: Embassy of Iceland in New Delhi · application checklist
Government of Iceland · Schengen applications

japan.name: Japan
japan.type: Tourist visa · Sightseeing without a guarantor
japan.intro: For a self-funded sightseeing trip using the New Delhi tourist checklist. If someone in Japan is guaranteeing your trip, ask for the checklist for that route.

sections.title: Application and itinerary
docs: Current passport and any old passports, plus A4 copies of the first and last pages of the current passport.
A signed visa application and a recent passport photograph on a white background.
A covering letter, flight or cruise schedule and day-by-day itinerary with accommodation and contact details in Japan.

sections.title: Who is paying for the trip
docs: Your latest income tax return. If unavailable, the New Delhi checklist accepts six months of bank statements.
For a student or dependant supported by a parent or spouse, prepare the sponsor’s consent, financial evidence and proof of relationship.
For travel with dependants, include relationship documents such as a marriage or birth certificate.

japan.timing: The embassy advises applying well ahead of travel. Application volume can affect the decision date.

sources.label: Japan visa application centre · New Delhi tourist checklist
Embassy of Japan in India · visa guidance

new-zealand.name: New Zealand
new-zealand.intro: For a holiday or a family visit in New Zealand. The application asks how you will support yourself during your stay and how you will leave at the end.

sections.title: Identity and plans
docs: A clear copy of the identity pages of each traveller’s passport and a recent photograph that meets Immigration New Zealand’s specifications.
Your day-by-day itinerary, planned accommodation and any invitation from family or friends.
An onward ticket, evidence of funds to buy one, or evidence that an eligible sponsor will cover onward travel.

sections.title: Money and supporting evidence
docs: Evidence of savings and income, such as recent statements or payslips showing salary credits. The India checklist gives three months as an example.
Income tax returns where relevant. The India visitor checklist gives the last two years as an example.
If using formal sponsorship, prepare the sponsorship information Immigration New Zealand requests and evidence of the sponsor’s eligibility.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: Family and translations
docs: For family members included in the application, prepare marriage or birth records showing the relationship.
Provide English translations of supporting documents issued in another language, following Immigration New Zealand’s translation requirements.

sources.label: Immigration New Zealand · Visitor Visa
Immigration New Zealand · India checklist for visits under six months

norway.name: Norway
norway.intro: When Norway is your main destination, register with the Norwegian Directorate of Immigration (UDI) online before handing in your documents.
norway.rateNote: Pay the consular fee through UDI when registering online. The application centre collects its separate service fee.

sections.title: Before your appointment
docs: A passport issued within the past 10 years, with two blank pages and at least three months’ validity after you plan to leave the Schengen area.
Current and previous passports, copies of the identity and used passport pages, and a recent passport photograph.
The signed application printout from the UDI portal and appointment confirmation.
Travel medical insurance for every Schengen country and every day of the trip, with at least €30,000 cover for emergency treatment, hospital care and repatriation.

sections.title: Itinerary, accommodation and funds
docs: Return transport reservations, accommodation for every country and a daily itinerary. The embassy advises waiting for the visa before buying flights.
For an organised tour or cruise, take the booking itinerary and payment confirmation.
Personal bank statements for the last three months and work, school or leave evidence as relevant.

sections.title: Other documents for your circumstances
docs: For a child travelling alone or with one parent, bring legalised consent from the absent parent or parents, or sole-custody evidence.
If using a representative, check whether to include the UDI power-of-attorney form.
Prepare A4 copies and arrange authorised translations for documents in languages other than English or Norwegian.

sources.label: Norwegian Embassy in India · visitor documents and payment

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.intro: Prepare your signed application and photograph first. Applications from abroad can go through the relevant Singapore mission or an appointed visa agent. A qualifying local contact can also apply online.

sections.title: Application essentials
docs: Completed Form 14A signed by the applicant.
A copy of the passport biodata page. The passport must be valid for at least six months from entry into Singapore.
A recent passport-sized colour photograph taken within three months, on a plain white background. For a print, use 35 mm wide by 45 mm high.
If requested, a letter of introduction from a qualifying Singapore contact or the other supporting documents specified by the mission.

sections.title: For your travel file
docs: Your return itinerary and hotel or host details, with consistent travel dates.
For a first visit, have recent bank statements and income evidence available if requested. The amount needed depends on the trip.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: Family travel
docs: A marriage or birth certificate where needed to document a relationship or sponsorship.
If your child is travelling without both parents, tell us who is accompanying them so we can check the consent documents.

sources.label: Singapore Immigration & Checkpoints Authority · Indian passport holders

south-korea.name: South Korea
south-korea.intro: This short-stay tourist checklist follows the New Delhi application centre. If your address falls under another Korean consulate, use that centre’s current forms.

sections.title: Application documents
docs: Original passport with at least six months’ validity.
Complete the Korea Visa Portal form, print and sign it. Prepare a recent photograph to the application centre’s specifications.
The health condition report and declaration on the New Delhi centre’s current checklist.
Your planned itinerary and travel details. Check the latest centre instructions before submitting.

sections.title: Bank and tax evidence
docs: Your personal bank statements for the last six months.
For individual applicants, two years of income tax returns. Business applicants should prepare three years of personal returns. If returns are unavailable, include an explanation.

Salaried: Employment certificate and six months of payslips.
Self-employed: Company registration certificate and the MSME record or business profile form. Company tax returns may also support the file.
Student: A bonafide certificate confirming current enrolment.
Retired: Have pension or other income evidence available if the centre asks how you will fund the visit.

sources.label: Korea Visa Application Centre in New Delhi · C-3-9 checklist
Korea Visa Application Centre in New Delhi · forms and updates

turkey.name: Türkiye (Turkey)
turkey.intro: Check e-visa eligibility before choosing a rate. For Indian ordinary passport holders, the supporting visa or residence permit you hold can determine which route is available.

sections.title: If you qualify for the e-visa
docs: Your current passport and travel dates. Check every eligibility condition shown by the official e-visa portal.
A qualifying visa or residence permit from a Schengen country, the USA, the UK or Ireland, valid when you enter Türkiye. The embassy excludes electronic visas as supporting documents.
If the supporting visa is in an old passport, have both the old passport and your current passport ready.

sections.title: If applying for a sticker visa in New Delhi
docs: A signed application, original passport with blank pages and recent biometric photographs meeting the centre’s specifications. Have local address proof if your passport was issued in another jurisdiction.
A signed covering letter with dates, purpose, companions and who pays. Include return flight reservations, accommodation or a host invitation, and travel insurance for the full stay.
Recent personal bank statements and tax returns. If someone sponsors you, include their letter, financial evidence, ID and proof of relationship.

sections.title: Work or study evidence for the sticker application

Salaried: Employer leave letter, recent payslips and salary-account statements.
Self-employed: Company registration and GST evidence, with notarisation where the centre requires it.
Student: School or college ID and leave approval or holiday confirmation.
Retired: Retirement documents and statements showing income.

sections.title: Children applying for a sticker visa
docs: Check the New Delhi centre’s consent and notarisation instructions for each child, including when both parents travel. Prepare the parents’ passport copies and any relevant custody papers.

sources.label: Turkish Embassy in New Delhi · e-visa eligibility for Indian travellers
Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs · sticker visas and travel documents

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.aliases: UK Great Britain England Scotland Wales Northern Ireland London
uk.intro: For a holiday or family visit to the UK. Your documents should show what you plan to do, how you will pay and why you will return to India.

sections.title: Application and visit details
docs: A passport valid for your whole stay, with a blank page for the visa if needed.
Your completed Standard Visitor application and visa application centre appointment details.
Planned dates, where you expect to stay and an estimate of your trip costs. UK guidance lists hotel and flight bookings as less useful evidence for a tourist visit.

sections.title: Finances and ties to India
docs: Recent bank statements showing income, regular activity and the source of funds you plan to spend.
Evidence of your circumstances, such as salary records, tax records, pension income or ownership of a business. Match the figures you give on your form.

Salaried: Leave approval or an employment letter showing your role and return date.
Recent payslips showing your regular income.
Self-employed: Business registration or GST certificate showing your link to the business.
Business bank statements or tax returns showing trading income.
Student: School or college ID and an enrolment or leave letter.
If a parent is paying, evidence of their income and your relationship.
Retired: Pension statements or a retirement letter showing your regular income.

sections.title: If someone is hosting or paying
docs: An invitation or letter explaining who will cover travel and living expenses and how you know the sponsor.
Evidence that your sponsor can cover the costs. If they are in the UK, include evidence of their lawful UK status.

sections.title: Children and translations
docs: Proof of the parent or guardian relationship and consent where needed for a child’s travel or care arrangements.
A full translation that can be independently verified for documents in languages other than English or Welsh.

uk.timing: UKVI says a Standard Visitor decision usually takes three weeks after your appointment. Allow time to book the appointment and respond to any document requests.

sources.label: UK Visas and Immigration · Standard Visitor application
UK Visas and Immigration · supporting documents

usa.name: United States
usa.aliases: USA US America United States of America
usa.intro: For a holiday or a visit to family in the United States. Each traveller needs an individual application, including children.
usa.rateNote: We can help arrange an earlier interview appointment if a slot opens. A separate service charge applies. The consulate controls appointment availability.

sections.title: To start your file
docs: Have your own email address and phone number ready for the application.
Prepare clear copies of your passport’s first and last pages. Keep the original passport for your appointment.
Prepare your intended travel dates, previous travel and employment details for the DS-160.

sections.title: For the appointment
docs: Your valid passport, DS-160 confirmation page and appointment confirmation.
Fee receipt if required and a printed photograph meeting US specifications if the online photo upload failed.
Evidence of your purpose of travel, your ties to India and how you will cover your expenses, if requested by the consular officer.

usa.timing: Interview availability and visa processing are separate. An earlier interview does not determine when a decision or passport will be ready.

sources.label: US Department of State · visitor visas and interview documents
US Department of State · global visa wait times

vietnam.name: Vietnam
vietnam.intro: The online application uses your passport image, a separate portrait and the details of your trip. Check the spelling of your full name and the passport number before submitting.

sections.title: Files to prepare
docs: A clear colour scan of the full passport biodata page, with all edges visible and text legible.
A recent, front-facing 4 × 6 cm colour portrait against a white background, with eyes visible and no glasses. Follow the portal’s current upload instructions.

sections.title: Trip details
docs: Your planned arrival and departure dates and the entry and exit points you intend to use.
Your intended address in Vietnam and an email address you can access to check the result.
After approval, review the name, passport number, visa dates and entry conditions before travelling.

sources.label: Vietnam Immigration Department · national e-visa portal
